new_relations.title: Fatherhood can be relational belonging mediated by Spirit
new_relations.project_anchor: The project distinguishes biological/legal parentage from symbolic or relational Fatherhood and treats Spirit as the connective relation.
new_relations.biblical_structure: Spirit, adoption, children/heirs and the address to Father are joined in one relational sequence
new_relations.source_direction: Project relational-Father/Spirit distinction first; Romans comparison later.
new_relations.mismatch: Paul's adoption theology belongs to Christian salvation and does not establish modern spiritual parentage.
